annotations.title: Employer cost of an employee in 17 countries (2026)

description: What an employee costs the employer on top of the salary, with 2026 rules, in the UAE, Singapore, United Kingdom, Spain, Italy, France, Germany, Switzerland, Poland, United States, Canada, Portugal, Netherlands, Uruguay, Thailand, India and Denmark. Adds employer social security and payroll taxes, mandatory pensions (incl. UK and Polish auto-enrolment) and end-of-service accruals (UAE and Indian gratuity, Italian TFR). Leaves out industry-rated accident insurance, health plans, visas and benefits. Give one or more ISO country codes and an annual gross salary in any of USD, EUR, GBP, AED, CHF, SGD, CAD, PLN, DKK, INR, THB, UYU (converted at ECB reference rates of 27 Nov 2026). Returns the line items in local currency, the total employer cost, % of salary and the totals in the input currency, sorted from cheapest. Options: uae_employee expat|emirati, uae_basic_pct (default 60), sg_employee local|foreign, ch_age 35-44|25-34|45-54|55-65. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/employer-cost-calculator/

currency.description: Currency of the salary. Default USD

salary.description: Annual gross salary, including any 13th/14th month or holiday allowance (e.g. 60000)
